title: ownership.transferred v1 data
description: `data` of the event envelope (event-envelope.schema.json) with eventType `ownership.transferred`, eventVersion 1, producer `building-service` (TECH-SPEC-F4 Observability, UO-10). Identifiers and share only: no contact details or document contents. Written to building_outbox in the transfer's transaction; the same eventId is used on every delivery attempt.

share.description: Percentage points moved, at most 4 decimals.

effectiveDate.description: Asia/Dhaka calendar date of the change.

effectiveAt.description: Server instant the change took effect.

revision.description: Unit ownership revision; orders same-day changes.
